tools.name: discover
tools.description: Search all feeds for endpoints matching a need. Returns up to `limit` ranked endpoints with price, params and latency (`latency.by_region`: cache-miss ms per Cloudflare region).

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free trimmed sample of an endpoint's real response from the probe's cached copy (no key, no payment): see the data shape before paying. Works for results discover marks sample: true.

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: List all live feeds with endpoint counts, per-call price range, plans and their paid MCP URL.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price an endpoint without calling it: x402 `accepts` for one call plus time-pass plans. Nothing is charged.

tools.name: call_feed
tools.description: Call a feed endpoint through the gateway with your API key (or an x402 payment). Without either it returns the 402 payment options.

tools.name: create_free_key
tools.description: Create a free API key (1,000 calls/month, all feeds) for the user's real email. Works at once; signing in at realtimeapi.ai with that email later re-issues the secret once.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_free_key" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a free API key (1,000 calls/month, all feeds) for the user's real email. Works at once; signing in at realtimeapi.ai with that email later re-issues the …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discover, list_feeds · Private data: call_feed, create_free_key · Public sink: create_free_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discover, list_feeds · Private data: call_feed, create_free_key · Public sink: create_free_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
